verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL: join hit-rate 1.80% < 5% floor. Bulk measured-numeric sources (Wikidata quantity claims) do not reach this substrate's sparse tail via exact-ID join; the tail is dominated by entities with no measured-data analog (proper nouns, rare taxonomic leaves, abstract relations). Do NOT build the literal-fusion pipeline (Phase 1-3) on this basis; the next grounding channel to try is gloss/definition text (WordNet/Wiktionary), not numeric literals.
cross_threshold_caveat: sample is scoped to support==1 entities; any hit trivially crosses 1->2, so this fraction is a degenerate corollary of the scoping, not an independent signal -- see prereg.
